retained: ScriptRunner retains the internal recursively immutable document revision until postMessage makes the worker-bound copy; mutable inputs retain the defensive toJSON fallback.
rejected: Direct host/worker channel plus iframe error channel did not measurably improve the five/64-layer fixtures or 64000-point fixture. Restored the original relay transport.
measurement: Production Chromium; each heavy trial runs five fresh read-only scripts over 64 hidden strokes with 1000 points each. Hidden artwork excludes rendering from this script transport diagnostic.
results_summary: Heavy baseline median 381.9 ms; retained optimization 349.6 ms and 352 ms repeat. Small-document startup remains approximately unchanged.
limitations: Observational local trials, no global responsiveness claim. Parsing, startup and remaining copies still leave heavy scripts substantially delayed.

validation.browser: 13 script/plugin tests passed, including snapshot capture during host edits/staged rollback, network isolation, timeout, cancellation, revision checks, patch and healing host services
validation.productionTimings: Small-payload fixtures and heavy fixture passed, including repeated heavy measurement
